label: Entry / Triage
function: Identify presenting problem, urgency, fit, care level, immediate risk
approach_ancestry: Clinical assessment; crisis work; CBT protocols; DBT; psychiatric triage

label: Safety + Ethical Frame
function: Consent, confidentiality limits, risk procedures, scope, boundaries, referral thresholds
approach_ancestry: All approaches; DBT/crisis; trauma-informed care; ethics codes

label: Engagement / Alliance
function: Bond, task agreement, goal agreement, empathy, collaboration, rupture-repair
approach_ancestry: Psychodynamic alliance theory; person-centered; CBT collaboration; EFT; systemic
primary_source: Bordin (1979); Flückiger et al. (2018); Elliott et al. (2018)

label: Assessment
function: Map symptoms, functioning, risk, history, strengths, context, culture, readiness, preferences
approach_ancestry: Evidence-based assessment; CBT; psychiatric diagnosis; systemic; ACT

label: Case Formulation
function: Convert assessment into living causal/functional map with maintaining loops
approach_ancestry: CBT conceptualization; psychodynamic; schema; ACT; systemic; EFT

label: Goal Agreement
function: Define shared treatment targets aligned with client values and priorities
approach_ancestry: CBT collaborative empiricism; ACT values; IPT; DBT hierarchy; solution-focused

label: Change Work / Intervention
function: Targeted methods changing cognition, behavior, emotion, relations, skills, meaning, context
approach_ancestry: CBT; exposure; BA; DBT; ACT; EFT; psychodynamic; schema; Gestalt; IPT; systemic
primary_source: Wampold & Imel (2015); Barth et al. (2013); Hayes & Hofmann (2018)

label: Practice + Generalization
function: Transfer session learning into life: homework, experiments, exposure, skills practice
approach_ancestry: CBT homework; DBT skills; ACT committed action; exposure; systemic tasks

label: Outcome Monitoring
function: Track symptoms, functioning, alliance, goals, risk, deterioration, not-on-track cases
approach_ancestry: Measurement-based care; feedback-informed treatment; CBT tracking

label: Review + Adaptation
function: Repair alliance, revise formulation, change intervention, step care, refer, adjust goals
approach_ancestry: Process-based therapy; measurement-based care; integrative; supervision
primary_source: Hayes & Hofmann (2018); Lambert et al. (2018); Norcross & Wampold (2019)

label: Consolidation / Termination / Maintenance
function: Summarize gains, relapse prevention, booster routes, transfer agency to client
approach_ancestry: CBT relapse prevention; ACT maintenance; DBT; psychodynamic termination

label: Bond
function: Emotional attachment and trust between client and therapist

label: Task Agreement
function: Consensus on in-therapy activities

label: Goal Agreement (alliance facet)
function: Consensus on outcomes sought

label: Empathy / Validation
function: Accurate empathic understanding communicated

label: Collaboration
function: Shared work posture and mutuality

label: Rupture Detection + Repair
function: Notice and repair alliance strains

label: Presenting Problem
function: Anchor complaint of the formulation cycle

label: Triggers
function: Situational and internal antecedents

label: Emotion / Body State
function: Affective and somatic activation

label: Meaning / Belief / Schema
function: Cognitive-schematic appraisal layer

label: Action / Avoidance / Coping
function: Behavioral response incl. avoidance and safety behaviors

label: Consequences
function: Short- and long-term outcomes closing the maintaining loop

label: Relationships + Context
function: Interpersonal and contextual inputs to triggers and meanings

label: Protective Factors
function: Strengths and buffers that dampen consequences

label: Cognitive Change
function: Restructuring, reappraisal, defusion

label: Behavioral Change
function: Activation, exposure, contingency management

label: Emotional Processing
function: Accessing, deepening, transforming emotion

label: Relational Change
function: Corrective relational experience; transference work; interpersonal patterns

label: Skills + Regulation
function: Emotion regulation, distress tolerance, interpersonal skills

label: Meaning + Identity
function: Values, narrative, identity integration

label: Context Change
function: Environmental, family, systemic modification

label: Symptom Tracking
function: Repeated standardized symptom measurement

label: Functioning Tracking
function: Role, social, occupational functioning

label: Alliance Monitoring
function: Session-level alliance ratings
primary_source: Flückiger et al. (2018); Lambert et al. (2018)

label: Risk Change
function: Ongoing risk re-screening

label: Adverse-Effect Detection
function: Systematic monitoring of negative effects and deterioration
primary_source: Strauss et al. (2021); Strauss et al. (2026)

label: Not-on-Track Detection
function: Algorithmic/clinical flags for expected-trajectory deviation
